son_2026_roni_source: Sep–Nov 2026 RONI is not yet published. The outlook uses CPC's central estimate, +2.53 ± 0.25 °C: CPC's ENSO discussion of 2026-10-08 gives a 54% chance of a Sep–Nov RONI of +2.5 °C or more, which with a spread of 0.25 °C puts the middle of its distribution at +2.53 °C. The estimate is refreshed with each CPC discussion and replaced by the observed value in early December.
